name: SIO lib ctx
script:
# SIO lib ctx: who is calling and what they may do.
# Other SIO scripts call:  ctx = run_script("SIO lib ctx").sio_ctx
user = frappe.session.user
roles = []
if user != "Guest":
    roles = [r[0] for r in frappe.db.sql(
        "select role from `tabHas Role` where parent=%s and parenttype='User'", user)]
is_admin = user == "Administrator" or "System Manager" in roles or "SIO Admin" in roles
is_finance = is_admin or "SIO Finance" in roles
is_unit_admin = is_admin or "SIO Unit Admin" in roles

member = None
if user != "Guest":
    member = frappe.db.get_value(
        "SIO Member", {"user": user},
        ["name", "full_name", "photo", "mobile", "email", "member_role", "status", "unit", "area", "campus", "course",
         "year_of_study", "home_town", "joined_on", "latitude", "longitude", "location_note", "username", "life_stage",
         "profession", "workplace", "current_city", "mentor_topics", "phone_visibility", "hide_games"],
        as_dict=True)

if member:
    status = member.status
elif is_admin:
    status = "Active"
else:
    status = "None"
active = status == "Active"
is_member = active and (is_unit_admin or is_finance or "SIO Member" in roles)
unit = member.unit if member else None

# Who sees what. Area admins (overall admins) and finance see every unit. Area presidents and secretaries see
# the units of their own area. Everyone else sees only their own unit.
AREA_ROLES = ("Area President", "Area Secretary")
area = None
if member:
    area = member.get("area") or (frappe.db.get_value("SIO Unit", unit, "district") if unit else None)
is_area_lead = bool(member) and active and member.member_role in AREA_ROLES and not (is_admin or is_finance)
if is_admin or is_finance:
    units = None  # every unit
elif is_area_lead:
    units = [u[0] for u in frappe.db.sql("select name from `tabSIO Unit` where district = %s", area or "__none__")]
elif unit:
    units = [unit]
else:
    units = []
# units whose expense approver this person is
approver_units = []
if member:
    approver_units = [u[0] for u in frappe.db.sql(
        "select name from `tabSIO Unit` where expense_approver = %s", member.name)]

caps = {
    "rsvp": active and member is not None,
    "register_events": status in ("Active", "Pending Approval") and member is not None,
    "offer": status in ("Active", "Pending Approval") and member is not None,
    "collect": is_member,
    "claim_expense": is_member and member is not None,
    "view_members": is_unit_admin,
    "approve_members": is_unit_admin,
    "mark_attendance": is_unit_admin,
    "schedule_meeting": is_unit_admin,
    "schedule_area_meeting": is_admin or is_area_lead,
    "view_collection_totals": is_unit_admin or is_finance,
    "approve_expense": is_finance or is_area_lead or len(approver_units) > 0,
    "send_notice": is_unit_admin,
    "all_units": is_admin or is_finance or is_area_lead,  # works across more than one unit
    "view_accounts": is_unit_admin or is_finance,
    "manage_collections": is_admin or is_finance or is_area_lead,
    "manage_events": is_unit_admin,
    "add_members": is_unit_admin,
    "manage_units": is_admin or is_area_lead,
    "handle_feedback": is_admin,  # bug reports and feedback inbox
    "view_donors": is_unit_admin or is_finance or is_member,
    "request_funds": is_unit_admin and member is not None,
    "approve_funds": is_finance or is_area_lead,
}

# Old single-unit scope, kept so nothing can widen by mistake: None = every unit; a unit name; or for area
# leads a value that matches no unit (scripts use units / in_scope instead).
scope = None
if units is not None:
    scope = unit if (unit and not is_area_lead) else "__area__"

if member:
    role_label = member.member_role
elif is_admin:
    role_label = "Area Admin"
else:
    role_label = None

me = {
    "user": user,
    "full_name": member.full_name if member else frappe.get_fullname(user),
    "member": member.name if member else None,
    "photo": member.get("photo") if member else None,
    "member_role": role_label,
    "status": status,
    "unit": unit,
    "area": area,
    "level": "all" if units is None else ("area" if is_area_lead else "unit"),
    "mobile": member.mobile if member else None,
    "email": member.email if member else user,
    "campus": member.campus if member else None,
    "course": member.course if member else None,
    "year_of_study": member.year_of_study if member else None,
    "home_town": member.home_town if member else None,
    "latitude": member.latitude if member else None,
    "longitude": member.longitude if member else None,
    "location_note": member.location_note if member else None,
    "joined_on": member.joined_on if member else None,
    "username": member.username if member else None,
    "life_stage": member.life_stage if member else None,
    "profession": member.profession if member else None,
    "workplace": member.workplace if member else None,
    "current_city": member.current_city if member else None,
    "mentor_topics": member.mentor_topics if member else None,
    "phone_visibility": (member.phone_visibility or "Leaders only") if member else None,
    "hide_games": 1 if (member and member.hide_games) else 0,
    "capabilities": caps,
    "approver_units": approver_units,
}

frappe.flags.sio_ctx = {
    "user": user,
    "member": member,
    "status": status,
    "active": active,
    "unit": unit,
    "is_admin": is_admin,
    "is_finance": is_finance,
    "is_unit_admin": is_unit_admin,
    "is_member": is_member,
    "caps": caps,
    "scope": scope,
    "units": units,
    "area": area,
    "is_area_lead": is_area_lead,
    "approver_units": approver_units,
    "me": me,
}

name: SIO lib events
script:
# SIO lib events: events this person can see. 
# Args: upcoming_only (0/1), limit, since_days (how far back completed ones go; default 60, e.g. for albums 730).
# Result: frappe.flags.sio_events
ctx = run_script("SIO lib ctx").sio_ctx
upcoming_only = frappe.utils.cint(frappe.form_dict.get("upcoming_only"))
limit = min(frappe.utils.cint(frappe.form_dict.get("limit")) or 50, 500)
since_days = min(max(frappe.utils.cint(frappe.form_dict.get("since_days")) or 60, 1), 3650)

conds = ["e.status != 'Cancelled'"]
if upcoming_only:
    conds.append("e.starts_on >= %(now)s and e.status in ('Registrations Open', 'Planning')")
else:
    conds.append("(e.starts_on >= %(since)s or e.status != 'Completed')")
if ctx["units"] is not None:
    # area-wide events of my area, and events of the units I may see
    conds.append("((ifnull(e.unit, '') = '' and (ifnull(e.area, '') = '' or e.area = %(area)s)) or e.unit in %(units)s)")
if not ctx["is_member"]:
    conds.append("e.open_to = 'Everyone'")

params = {
    "now": frappe.utils.now_datetime(),
    "since": frappe.utils.add_days(frappe.utils.nowdate(), -since_days),
    "unit": ctx["unit"] or "__none__",
    "area": ctx["area"] or "__none__",
    "units": tuple(ctx["units"] or ["__none__"]),
    "member": ctx["member"].name if ctx["member"] else "__none__",
}
rows = frappe.db.sql(
    """select e.name, e.title, e.event_type, e.starts_on, e.ends_on, e.venue, e.status, e.capacity,
        e.registered_count, e.budget, e.spent, e.unit, e.open_to,
        (select r.status from `tabSIO Event Registration` r where r.event = e.name and r.member = %(member)s
         and r.status != 'Cancelled' limit 1) as my_registration
    from `tabSIO Event` e where """ + " and ".join(conds) + """
    order by (e.status = 'Completed'), e.starts_on asc limit """ + str(limit),
    params, as_dict=True)
if not ctx["is_unit_admin"]:
    for r in rows:
        r.pop("budget", None)
        r.pop("spent", None)
frappe.flags.sio_events = rows  # caller: run_script("SIO lib events").sio_events

name: SIO lib notices
script:
# SIO lib notices: updates this person should see. 
# Args: limit. Result: frappe.flags.sio_notices
ctx = run_script("SIO lib ctx").sio_ctx
limit = frappe.utils.cint(frappe.form_dict.get("limit")) or 50
m = ctx["member"]
units = ctx["units"]
params = {
    "unit": ctx["unit"] or "__none__",
    "units": tuple(units or ["__none__"]),
    "area": ctx["area"] or "__none__",
    "all": 1 if units is None else 0,
    "role": m.member_role if m else "__none__",
    "member": m.name if m else "__none__",
    "user": ctx["user"],
}
frappe.flags.sio_notices = frappe.db.sql(
    """select n.name, n.title, n.message, n.audience, n.unit, n.member_role, n.event, n.task, n.sent_on,
        n.recipient_count, n.sent_by
    from `tabSIO Notice` n
    where (n.audience = 'Everyone' and (%(all)s = 1 or ifnull(n.area, '') = '' or n.area = %(area)s))
        or (n.audience = 'Unit' and (n.unit = %(unit)s or n.unit in %(units)s))
        or (n.audience = 'Role' and n.member_role = %(role)s and (%(all)s = 1 or ifnull(n.area, '') = ''
            or n.area = %(area)s))
        or (n.audience = 'Event Registrants' and exists (select 1 from `tabSIO Event Registration` r
            where r.event = n.event and r.member = %(member)s and r.status != 'Cancelled'))
        or (n.audience = 'Person' and n.member = %(member)s)
        or (n.sent_by = %(user)s and n.audience != 'Person')
    order by n.sent_on desc limit """ + str(limit),
    params, as_dict=True)

name: SIO lib totals
script:
# SIO lib totals: totals for one collection, optionally one unit.
# Args: collection, unit. Result: frappe.flags.sio_totals
collection = frappe.form_dict.get("collection")
unit = frappe.form_dict.get("unit")
units = [u for u in (frappe.form_dict.get("units") or "").split("|") if u]
cond = "collection = %(collection)s"
if unit:
    cond = cond + " and unit = %(unit)s"
if units:
    cond = cond + " and unit in %(units)s"
r = frappe.db.sql(
    """select
        coalesce(sum(case when entry_type != 'Items' then offered_amount end), 0),
        coalesce(sum(case when entry_type != 'Items' then paid_amount end), 0),
        coalesce(sum(case when entry_type != 'Items' then balance_amount end), 0),
        coalesce(sum(case when entry_type = 'Items' then items_value end), 0),
        count(*)
    from `tabSIO Collection Entry` where """ + cond,
    {"collection": collection, "unit": unit, "units": tuple(units or ["__none__"])})[0]
frappe.flags.sio_totals = {
    "offered": frappe.utils.flt(r[0]),
    "collected": frappe.utils.flt(r[1]),
    "balance": frappe.utils.flt(r[2]),
    "items": frappe.utils.flt(r[3]),
    "entries": frappe.utils.cint(r[4]),
}

name: SIO lib collections
script:
# SIO lib collections: open collections (Ramadan Collection, Baithul Mal, ...) this person can see,
# each with totals for their scope and their own offers. Result: frappe.flags.sio_collections
ctx = run_script("SIO lib ctx").sio_ctx
caps = ctx["caps"]
member = ctx["member"]
filters = {"is_active": 1}
rows = frappe.get_all("SIO Collection", filters=filters,
                      fields=["name", "collection_type", "target_amount", "starts_on", "ends_on", "description", "unit",
                              "open_to"],
                      order_by="creation desc")
out = []
today = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())
for c in rows:
    # Each collection runs for its own period (Ramadan collection, Baithul Mal year ...). Outside it, members don't
    # see it; leaders still see an ended one to follow up balances.
    phase = "Running"
    if c.starts_on and frappe.utils.getdate(c.starts_on) > today:
        phase = "Upcoming"
    elif c.ends_on and frappe.utils.getdate(c.ends_on) < today:
        phase = "Ended"
    if phase == "Ended" and not caps["view_collection_totals"]:
        continue
    if c.unit and ctx["units"] is not None and c.unit not in ctx["units"]:
        continue
    open_to = c.open_to or "Everyone"
    # Baithul Mal and the like are for workers and above, not associates
    if open_to == "Workers and above" and not ctx["is_member"]:
        continue
    # the public donations fund is handled by finance only
    if open_to == "Public donations" and ctx["units"] is not None:
        continue
    item = {"name": c.name, "collection_type": c.collection_type, "target": frappe.utils.flt(c.target_amount),
            "starts_on": c.starts_on, "ends_on": c.ends_on, "description": c.description, "unit": c.unit,
            "totals": None, "my_offered": 0, "my_paid": 0, "unit_target": None, "open_to": open_to, "phase": phase,
            "my_pledge": None}
    if ctx["unit"]:
        ut = frappe.db.get_value("SIO Collection Unit Target",
                                 {"parent": c.name, "parenttype": "SIO Collection", "unit": ctx["unit"]}, "target")
        item["unit_target"] = frappe.utils.flt(ut) if ut else None
    if caps["view_collection_totals"]:
        scope_units = ctx["units"]
        item["totals"] = run_script("SIO lib totals", collection=c.name,
                                    units="" if scope_units is None else "|".join(scope_units or ["__none__"])).sio_totals
    elif caps["collect"] and member:
        t = frappe.db.sql(
            """select coalesce(sum(case when entry_type != 'Items' then offered_amount end), 0),
                coalesce(sum(paid_amount), 0), coalesce(sum(balance_amount), 0),
                coalesce(sum(case when entry_type = 'Items' then items_value end), 0), count(*)
            from `tabSIO Collection Entry` where collection = %s and collected_by = %s""", (c.name, member.name))[0]
        item["totals"] = {"offered": frappe.utils.flt(t[0]), "collected": frappe.utils.flt(t[1]),
                          "balance": frappe.utils.flt(t[2]), "items": frappe.utils.flt(t[3]),
                          "entries": frappe.utils.cint(t[4]), "scope": "collected_by_me"}
    if member:
        mine = frappe.db.sql(
            """select coalesce(sum(offered_amount), 0), coalesce(sum(paid_amount), 0) from `tabSIO Collection Entry`
            where collection = %s and contributor_member = %s""", (c.name, member.name))[0]
        item["my_offered"] = frappe.utils.flt(mine[0])
        item["my_paid"] = frappe.utils.flt(mine[1])
        p = frappe.db.get_value("SIO Collection Entry",
                                {"collection": c.name, "contributor_member": member.name, "monthly_amount": [">", 0]},
                                ["name", "pledge_basis", "pledge_base", "monthly_amount", "pledge_months",
                                 "paid_amount", "creation"], as_dict=True)
        if p:
            today = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())
            start = frappe.utils.getdate(p.creation)
            elapsed = (today.year - start.year) * 12 + today.month - start.month + 1
            elapsed = max(0, min(elapsed, frappe.utils.cint(p.pledge_months) or 12))
            due = frappe.utils.flt(p.monthly_amount) * elapsed - frappe.utils.flt(p.paid_amount)
            item["my_pledge"] = {"entry": p.name, "basis": p.pledge_basis, "base": p.pledge_base,
                                 "monthly": frappe.utils.flt(p.monthly_amount), "months": p.pledge_months,
                                 "months_so_far": elapsed, "paid": frappe.utils.flt(p.paid_amount),
                                 "due_now": max(due, 0)}
    out.append(item)
order = {"Running": 0, "Upcoming": 1, "Ended": 2}
out = sorted(out, key=lambda x: order.get(x["phase"], 3))
frappe.flags.sio_collections = out

name: SIO lib unit_progress
script:
# SIO lib unit_progress: each unit's progress in one collection against its target.
# Args: collection. Result: frappe.flags.sio_unit_progress (list, largest target first)
collection = frappe.form_dict.get("collection")
targets = {}
for t in frappe.get_all("SIO Collection Unit Target", filters={"parent": collection, "parenttype": "SIO Collection"},
                        fields=["unit", "target"]):
    targets[t.unit] = frappe.utils.flt(t.target)
sums = {}
for r in frappe.db.sql(
        """select unit,
            coalesce(sum(case when entry_type != 'Items' then offered_amount end), 0) as offered,
            coalesce(sum(case when entry_type != 'Items' then paid_amount end), 0) as collected,
            coalesce(sum(case when entry_type != 'Items' then balance_amount end), 0) as balance,
            coalesce(sum(case when entry_type = 'Items' then items_value end), 0) as items,
            count(*) as entries
        from `tabSIO Collection Entry` where collection = %s and ifnull(unit, '') != '' group by unit""",
        collection, as_dict=True):
    sums[r.unit] = r
rows = []
for unit in list(targets.keys()) + [u for u in sums if u not in targets]:
    s = sums.get(unit) or {}
    target = targets.get(unit, 0)
    collected = frappe.utils.flt(s.get("collected"))
    rows.append({
        "unit": unit,
        "target": target,
        "offered": frappe.utils.flt(s.get("offered")),
        "collected": collected,
        "balance": frappe.utils.flt(s.get("balance")),
        "items": frappe.utils.flt(s.get("items")),
        "entries": frappe.utils.cint(s.get("entries")),
        "pct": round(100.0 * collected / target) if target else None,
        "to_target": max(target - collected, 0) if target else None,
    })
rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (-r["target"], r["unit"]))
frappe.flags.sio_unit_progress = rows

name: SIO lib accounts
script:
# SIO lib accounts: money in (collection payments received) and out (expenses paid) with opening balance,
# running balance and summaries. Unit admins only ever see their own unit.
# Args: from_date, to_date, unit, collection, event. Result: frappe.flags.sio_accounts
#   collection: that fund's money in, and expenses marked "Paid From" that fund
#   event: only that event's expenses (events have no money in)
ctx = run_script("SIO lib ctx").sio_ctx
f = frappe.form_dict
today = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())
from_date = frappe.utils.getdate(f.get("from_date") or frappe.utils.get_first_day(today))
to_date = frappe.utils.getdate(f.get("to_date") or today)
unit = f.get("unit") or None
units = ctx["units"]  # None = every unit
if units is not None:
    if ctx["is_area_lead"]:
        if unit and unit not in units:
            unit = "__none__"
    else:
        unit = ctx["unit"] or "__none__"
# area presidents / secretaries looking at their whole area
area_units = tuple(units or ["__none__"]) if (units is not None and not unit) else None
collection = f.get("collection") or None
event = f.get("event") or None

in_cond = ["1=1"]
# Programme funds the area releases to a unit: for the area (no unit picked) they are money out, and the unit's
# spending from them is not counted again. For a unit they are money in, and its spending is money out.
out_cond = ["x.status = 'Paid'"]
if not unit:
    out_cond.append("ifnull(x.fund_request, '') = ''")
fr_cond = ["f.status in ('Released', 'Closed')"]
params = {"from": from_date, "to": to_date, "unit": unit, "collection": collection, "event": event,
          "units": area_units}
if area_units is not None:
    in_cond.append("e.unit in %(units)s")
    out_cond.append("x.unit in %(units)s")
    fr_cond.append("f.unit in %(units)s")
if unit:
    in_cond.append("e.unit = %(unit)s")
    out_cond.append("x.unit = %(unit)s")
    fr_cond.append("f.unit = %(unit)s")
if collection:
    in_cond.append("e.collection = %(collection)s")
    out_cond.append("x.paid_from = %(collection)s")
    fr_cond.append("f.paid_from = %(collection)s")
if event:
    in_cond.append("1=0")
    out_cond.append("x.event = %(event)s")
    fr_cond.append("f.event = %(event)s")
in_where = " and ".join(in_cond)
out_where = " and ".join(out_cond)
fr_where = " and ".join(fr_cond)

def total_in(date_cond):
    return frappe.utils.flt(frappe.db.sql(
        """select coalesce(sum(p.amount), 0) from `tabSIO Collection Payment` p
        join `tabSIO Collection Entry` e on e.name = p.parent and p.parenttype = 'SIO Collection Entry'
        where """ + in_where + " and " + date_cond, params)[0][0])

def total_out(date_cond):
    return frappe.utils.flt(frappe.db.sql(
        "select coalesce(sum(x.amount), 0) from `tabSIO Expense Claim` x where " + out_where + " and " + date_cond,
        params)[0][0])

def total_fr(date_cond):
    return frappe.utils.flt(frappe.db.sql(
        "select coalesce(sum(f.released_amount), 0) from `tabSIO Fund Request` f where " + fr_where + " and "
        + date_cond, params)[0][0])

fr_sign = 1 if unit else -1
opening = total_in("p.payment_date < %(from)s") - total_out("x.paid_on < %(from)s") \
    + fr_sign * total_fr("f.released_on < %(from)s")

ins = frappe.db.sql(
    """select p.payment_date as date, p.amount, p.mode, p.reference_no, e.name as ref, e.contributor_name as party,
        e.collection, e.unit, e.entry_type
    from `tabSIO Collection Payment` p
    join `tabSIO Collection Entry` e on e.name = p.parent and p.parenttype = 'SIO Collection Entry'
    where """ + in_where + """ and p.payment_date between %(from)s and %(to)s
    order by p.payment_date, e.name""", params, as_dict=True)
outs = frappe.db.sql(
    """select x.paid_on as date, x.amount, x.payment_mode as mode, x.name as ref, x.description, x.category,
        x.claimed_by_name as party, x.event, x.unit, x.paid_from
    from `tabSIO Expense Claim` x
    where """ + out_where + """ and x.paid_on between %(from)s and %(to)s
    order by x.paid_on, x.name""", params, as_dict=True)

frs = frappe.db.sql(
    """select f.released_on as date, f.released_amount as amount, f.payment_mode as mode, f.name as ref, f.title,
        f.unit, f.event, f.paid_from
    from `tabSIO Fund Request` f
    where """ + fr_where + """ and f.released_on between %(from)s and %(to)s
    order by f.released_on, f.name""", params, as_dict=True)

rows = []
for r in frs:
    rows.append({"date": r.date, "type": "In" if unit else "Out", "amount": frappe.utils.flt(r.amount),
                 "title": "Programme fund: " + (r.title or ""),
                 "party": "From the area" if unit else (r.unit or "") + " unit", "unit": r.unit,
                 "collection": r.paid_from, "event": r.event, "category": "Programme fund", "mode": r.mode,
                 "ref": r.ref, "doctype": "SIO Fund Request"})
for r in ins:
    rows.append({"date": r.date, "type": "In", "amount": frappe.utils.flt(r.amount), "title": r.collection,
                 "party": r.party, "unit": r.unit, "collection": r.collection, "event": None, "category": None,
                 "mode": r.mode, "ref": r.ref, "doctype": "SIO Collection Entry"})
for r in outs:
    rows.append({"date": r.date, "type": "Out", "amount": frappe.utils.flt(r.amount), "title": r.description,
                 "party": r.party, "unit": r.unit, "collection": r.paid_from, "event": r.event,

# With google_token (Continue with Google) the email comes from Google, no password is needed, and a sign-in
# token for this phone is returned.
# --- Google sign-in helpers (shared) ---
GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT = "280665319397-ggctdep18o9afufgc2a7nr3serc2bll0.apps.googleusercontent.com"


def google_identity(id_token):
    # Ask Google whether this ID token is genuine and meant for our app; returns email and name.
    if not id_token:
        frappe.throw(_("Google sign-in failed. Try again."))
    try:
        info = frappe.make_get_request("https://oauth2.googleapis.com/tokeninfo?id_token=" + id_token)
    except Exception:
        info = None
    if not info or info.get("aud") != GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT or str(info.get("email_verified")).lower() != "true" \
            or not info.get("email"):
        frappe.throw(_("Google sign-in could not be verified. Try again."))
    return {"email": info.get("email").strip().lower(), "name": info.get("name") or "",
            "picture": info.get("picture") or ""}


def issue_token(user_name, device):
    # A sign-in token for this phone (same mechanism as fingerprint sign-in): api_key:api_secret.
    u = frappe.get_doc("User", user_name)
    if not u.api_key:
        u.api_key = frappe.utils.generate_hash(length=15)
    secret = frappe.utils.generate_hash(length=15)
    u.api_secret = secret
    u.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "SIO Device Token", "user": user_name, "device_name": (device or "Phone")[:140],
                    "token_hash": frappe.utils.sha256_hash(secret),
                    "last_used": frappe.utils.now_datetime()}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    return u.api_key + ":" + secret

mobile = "".join([c for c in (f.get("mobile") or "") if c.isdigit() or c == "+"])
email = (f.get("email") or "").strip().lower()
password = f.get("password") or ""
via_google = bool(f.get("google_token"))
if via_google:
    email = google_identity(f.get("google_token"))["email"]
    password = frappe.utils.generate_hash(length=24)
unit = f.get("unit") or None
digits = "".join([c for c in mobile if c.isdigit()])
if len(full_name) < 3:
    frappe.throw(_("Enter your full name."))
if len(digits) < 10:
    frappe.throw(_("Enter a valid mobile number."))
if "@" not in email or "." not in email.split("@")[-1]:
    frappe.throw(_("Enter a valid email address."))
if len(password) < 8:

if unit and not frappe.db.exists("SIO Unit", {"name": unit, "active": 1}):

# SIO task reminders (every morning): follow up on open event tasks. A task due within 2 days, or late, gets a
# reminder to its person once a day; a task with no due date gets one when its event is within 3 days.
today = frappe.utils.nowdate()
soon = frappe.utils.add_days(today, 2)
rows = frappe.db.sql(
    """select t.name, t.title, t.assigned_to, t.due_on, t.last_reminded, e.name as event, e.title as event_title,
        e.starts_on
    from `tabSIO Event Task` t join `tabSIO Event` e on e.name = t.event
    where t.status != 'Done' and ifnull(t.assigned_to, '') != '' and e.status not in ('Completed', 'Cancelled')
        and (ifnull(t.last_reminded, '2000-01-01') < %(today)s)
        and ((t.due_on is not null and date(t.due_on) <= %(soon)s)
             or (t.due_on is null and date(e.starts_on) <= %(ev_soon)s and date(e.starts_on) >= %(today)s))""",
    {"today": today, "soon": soon, "ev_soon": frappe.utils.add_days(today, 3)}, as_dict=True)
for r in rows:
    late = r.due_on and frappe.utils.get_datetime(r.due_on) < frappe.utils.now_datetime()
    when = frappe.utils.format_datetime(r.due_on, "EEE d MMM, h:mm a") if r.due_on else ""
    frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "SIO Notice",
        "title": ("Overdue: " if late else "Reminder: ") + r.title,
        "message": "For " + r.event_title + (". Was due " if late else ". Due ") + (when or "before the event")
                   + ". Please finish it and mark it done in SIO Connect.",
        "audience": "Person", "member": r.assigned_to, "event": r.event, "task": r.name,
    }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.set_value("SIO Event Task", r.name, "last_reminded", today)
